$comment: rank-first config for the tools at the repo root (citation-share.mjs, market.mjs, ai-runs.mjs, serp.mjs, links.mjs…). Regenerated 2026-11-01 by apps/web/scripts/rank-config.mjs from src/lib/routes.js and data/facts.json (only fields with a real value; no [[FACT NEEDED]] field is guessed): it now has the Zoo page (/nous-trouver/zoo-de-granby/ and /en/visit/granby-zoo/), Instagram in sameAs (verified 2026-10-29, research/20b §0.1), the pillar /gateaux-personnalises-granby/ with its clusters (/gateau-pour-demain/, /prix/, /calculateur-portions-gateau/, /buches-de-noel/, /gateaux/; Layer 9.3 in links.mjs, docs/17 §4.4) and category.sentence (default option B, research/15 D19, pending the owner’s choice A or B, research/14 S5). It also writes nap.mobile, brand.alternateNames (the forms of the name that count as the brand in an answer or a map-pack listing: « Coco Vanille », « Cocovanille », scoreboard/README.md §3), facts (the facts file ai-runs.mjs reads, relative to this file) and market (where the measurement searches from: google.ca located on Granby, AI web search from Québec on America/Toronto time, North American phone numbers; without a market block the tools fall back to their Moroccan defaults). The competitors list is copied from scoreboard/competitors.csv for reference only: the tools read scoreboard/competitors.csv. Regenerate with: node apps/web/scripts/rank-config.mjs --out site.config.json (written over this file, it keeps $comment and competitors).
